whoIsThisFor.heading: Who may use these Education Cloud Consultant study notes?

personas.label: Higher education CRM consultants
personas.description: You help education institutions translate constituent, learner, admissions, or advancement needs into Salesforce solution designs.

personas.label: Salesforce admins at educational institutions
personas.description: You support Salesforce solutions at an education institution and want structured notes on implementation and product-design concepts.

personas.label: EdTech implementation partners
personas.description: You work with education customers on requirements, product choices, integrations, governance, and adoption.

examDifficulty.heading: Is the Education Cloud Consultant Exam Hard?
examDifficulty.summary: Salesforce’s published exam guide names this credential Salesforce Certified Education Cloud Consultant. The guide’s registration and exam dates have passed; Salesforce lists retirement effective February 1, 2027. Use the outline below as a historical guide reference, not as an active exam syllabus.
bullets: Published format: 60 multiple-choice questions and up to five unscored questions in 105 minutes; the published passing score is 67%.
Published fees: US$200 registration and US$100 retake; JPY 30,000 for each, plus applicable local tax.
Availability: registration ended July 24, 2026; the last exam date was August 31, 2026.
examDifficulty.passRateGuidance: No practice score guarantees an exam result. The exam is no longer available for registration or delivery; use Salesforce’s current product documentation and Trailhead learning resources for ongoing Education/Agentforce Education study.

examFormat.heading: Education Cloud Consultant Exam Format Explained
examFormat.intro: The published exam guide lists the format below. Registration and exam delivery have ended.
examFormat.scenarioPercent: Salesforce does not publish a scenario-question percentage. The historical guide’s domains include requirements-based solution design, configuration, implementation strategy, integration/data management, and analytics.
bestWayToPass: Start with requirements: Identify users, business processes, constraints, data ownership, outcomes, and existing systems before recommending a solution.

Compare product and data-model choices: Distinguish the Education Cloud platform solution from Education Data Architecture managed-package deployments; verify model-specific behavior in current documentation.
Plan implementation: Account for governance, change management, staffing, testing, deployment, adoption, and maintainability.
Assess integration and data: Document source-of-truth ownership, exchange direction, migration quality, error handling, and volume considerations.

certificationCard.description: Historical exam reference for Salesforce’s education implementation consultant credential. Salesforce now calls the product Agentforce Education; the exam guide’s domain outline aligns to Winter ’24 and is not a current exam syllabus.

keyConcepts.h2: Education Consultant: Product and Data-Model Study Notes

blocks.heading: EDA: Education Data Architecture Core Objects
blocks.body: Education Data Architecture (EDA) is a Salesforce for Education managed-package data model. Salesforce distinguishes it from the Education Cloud platform solution, now called Agentforce Education. Identify which product and model an institution uses before applying object and relationship assumptions; verify the relevant model in its current documentation.

blocks.heading: Student Success Hub: Alerts, Cases, and Appointments
blocks.body: Student success solutions should be designed around the institution’s goals, staff responsibilities, access policies, data sources, and intervention workflows. Confirm which licensed product features are available and how they behave before specifying alerts, cases, appointments, or plans.

blocks.heading: Recruiting and Admissions
blocks.body: Recruitment and admissions solutions can support the learner journey from initial interest through application and enrollment. Map the institution’s real process, required records, portal experience, staff handoffs, and external application-system interfaces before selecting configuration.

blocks.heading: Experience Cloud for Students and Faculty
blocks.body: Salesforce Help describes an online learner portal powered by Experience Cloud. Portal scope, record access, and available interactions depend on the institution’s products, licenses, configuration, and security requirements; validate those details in current documentation.

blocks.heading: Integration with SIS and LMS Systems
blocks.body: For SIS, LMS, and other integrations, establish source-of-truth ownership per data element, exchange direction and timing, reconciliation and error handling, privacy/access requirements, and migration constraints. Do not assume a single system-of-record pattern for every institution.

scenarioTips.intro: These prompts organize selected themes from the published guide’s domains. They are not predictions about the content of a current exam.

blocks.heading: Education Data Architecture (EDA)
blocks.body: First establish whether the scenario uses the EDA managed package or the Education Cloud platform solution. Then confirm the applicable account model and relationships in the documentation for that product.

blocks.heading: Student Lifecycle Management
blocks.body: Trace the user and institutional journey from recruitment and admissions to student success and alumni engagement. Verify product boundaries and required staff handoffs for the selected deployment.

blocks.heading: Program Enrollment & Course Management
blocks.body: Use the institution’s requirements to identify academic program, course, and enrollment data needs; verify object names and relationships against the selected data model.

blocks.heading: Advisor & Success Hub Configuration
blocks.body: For advising workflows, identify the goal, signal source, assigned staff, access rules, follow-up process, and currently licensed features.

blocks.heading: Reporting for Education
blocks.body: Connect reporting needs to decision-makers and data quality. Compare available reports and analytics options, noting governance and data-volume constraints.

nextCertsAfter.heading: Next Consultant Certifications
nextCertsAfter.intro: After this consultant certification, you can add adjacent clouds or deepen your specialisation:

sampleQuestions.question: A university needs to track an individual who is a prospective student, not yet attached to any organisation. How is this person stored?
options: As a user record in the org with a licence assigned for the applicant portal
As a contact attached to a placeholder account created for unaffiliated people
As a lead record that is converted only once they accept an offer of a place
As a person account
sampleQuestions.explanation: Education Cloud uses person accounts so an individual exists in their own right, which suits students who are not employees of an organisation.
whyWrong: A user record is for someone logging in, not for the person being tracked.
A placeholder account is the workaround person accounts were designed to remove.
Leads lose the relationship history a prospective student accumulates.

sampleQuestions.question: What does an affiliation record represent?
options: A relationship between a person and an organisation
The set of courses a student has enrolled on during a given academic term
The advisor who has been assigned to support the student through their degree
The financial aid package that has been awarded to a particular student
sampleQuestions.explanation: Affiliations connect a person to an organisation such as a school, department or employer, with a role and a date range.
whyWrong: Course enrolment is held on course connection records.
Advisor relationships are their own kind of connection.
Financial aid is tracked separately from affiliations.

sampleQuestions.question: A student enrols on a degree programme and then takes six courses within it. How is this modelled?
options: An opportunity record for the programme with six product line items on it
A single affiliation record listing all six of the courses in its description
A program enrollment with course connections beneath it
Six separate program enrollments, one created for each of the courses taken
sampleQuestions.explanation: Program enrollment represents membership of the programme, and course connections record the individual courses taken within it.
whyWrong: Opportunities track fundraising and admissions, not enrolment structure.
Course detail in free text cannot be reported on.
Each course is a connection, not a separate programme.

sampleQuestions.question: Why does Education Cloud model a household as well as the individual student?
options: Family members are often involved in decisions and giving
Course connections can only be created for students who belong to a household
Regulators require every student's home address to be stored on a separate object
The platform is unable to store more than one address against a person account
sampleQuestions.explanation: Recruitment, financial aid and alumni giving all involve parents and siblings, so the household gives those relationships somewhere to live.
whyWrong: Household membership is not a prerequisite for enrolment.
No such regulatory requirement exists.
Person accounts can hold multiple addresses.

sampleQuestions.question: An admissions team needs to track an applicant through review, interview and decision. What fits best?
options: A task assigned to an admissions officer for every stage the applicant reaches
A case raised against the applicant for each step of the admissions process
A new program enrollment created at the start of each stage of the process
An application record with stages
sampleQuestions.explanation: An application record moves through defined stages, which is what gives the team a pipeline view and consistent reporting.
whyWrong: Tasks record activity but do not model the applicant's progress.
Cases are for issues and queries rather than a defined pipeline.
Enrolment happens after admission, not during it.

sampleQuestions.question: What is the purpose of an advisor link or relationship record?
options: It holds the advisor's own employment details and contract information
It records who supports a student and in what capacity
It tracks the fees that the student owes for the advisory service provided
It lists the courses the advisor is responsible for teaching in the term
sampleQuestions.explanation: Advising relationships need to be explicit so the institution knows who is responsible for a student and can report on caseloads.
whyWrong: Staff employment data belongs in human resources.
Advising is not normally charged for separately.
Teaching responsibility is a different relationship.

sampleQuestions.question: A student takes a leave of absence and returns the following year. What should happen to their records?
options: The original program enrollment is deleted and recreated on their return
The history is retained and a new enrolment period recorded
A second person account is created to represent the returning student
The affiliation is edited so that the gap in attendance is not visible
sampleQuestions.explanation: Academic history matters for progression and reporting, so the record of what happened is kept and the new period added alongside it.
whyWrong: Deleting enrolment loses the courses already completed.
A duplicate person account splits the student's entire history.
Hiding a genuine gap misrepresents the student's record.

sampleQuestions.question: Why is the educational institution hierarchy useful?
options: It reflects how faculties and departments actually nest
It controls which members of staff are able to log in to the system at all
It determines the order in which students are offered places on a course
It sets the tuition fee that applies to each of the programmes on offer
sampleQuestions.explanation: Universities are structured in layers, and modelling that hierarchy lets you roll reporting and access up and down it.
whyWrong: Login access is governed by users and profiles.
Offer sequencing is an admissions decision.
Fees are held against programmes and courses.

sampleQuestions.question: An institution wants to know which recruitment events led to enrolments. What makes this possible?
options: Asking each enrolled student to recall which events they attended before
Comparing the number of events held with the total intake for that year
Linking event attendance through to the application
Counting the total number of people who attended each event in the period
sampleQuestions.explanation: Attribution needs the chain from attendance to application to enrolment, which means the records have to be connected rather than counted separately.
whyWrong: Recollection is unreliable and incomplete.
Comparing totals shows correlation at best.
Attendance counts alone cannot show what converted.

sampleQuestions.question: What distinguishes a course from a course offering?
options: The course is for undergraduates and the offering is for postgraduates
The course is taught in person while the offering is delivered online only
The course is the definition; the offering is a specific run of it
The course is created by faculty and the offering by the admissions team
sampleQuestions.explanation: A course exists as a catalogue entry, and each offering is that course delivered in a particular term by a particular instructor.
whyWrong: Both apply at any level of study.
Delivery mode is an attribute, not the distinction.
Who creates the record is not what separates the two concepts.

sampleQuestions.question: A consultant finds the client storing student data in a custom object they built themselves. What should they weigh?
options: Whether the client has enough custom object capacity left in their org
Whether the custom object could be renamed to match the standard one instead
Whether the custom object can be moved into a separate Salesforce org
Whether the standard model already covers the requirement
sampleQuestions.explanation: Standard Education Cloud objects carry behaviour, reporting and future upgrades, so departing from them needs a reason the standard model cannot meet.
whyWrong: Capacity is rarely the real constraint; suitability is.
Renaming does not give the object the standard model's behaviour.
Moving data to another org fragments the institution's records.

sampleQuestions.question: Why would an institution use program enrollments rather than opportunities to track student participation?
options: Opportunities are unable to store any date fields for start and end periods
Enrolment is an ongoing state, not a deal to be won
Program enrollments are the only object that can relate to a person account
Opportunities cannot be reported on alongside the other education objects
sampleQuestions.explanation: Opportunities model a sales pipeline that closes. Enrolment is a continuing relationship with a start, an end and a status.
whyWrong: Opportunities do have date fields; the mismatch is conceptual.
Many objects can relate to a person account.
Opportunities report perfectly well alongside other objects.

sampleQuestions.question: An alumni office wants to track giving alongside academic history. What makes this straightforward?
options: A separate alumni database synchronised with the student system each night
A second person account created for the individual once they graduate
The same person record carries both
A rule preventing academic records from being edited after graduation
sampleQuestions.explanation: Because the person persists across the whole lifecycle, their study history and their giving sit on the same record rather than in two systems.
whyWrong: A nightly sync between two systems invites drift and duplication.
A second account splits the person in half.
Locking records does not connect giving to academic history.

sampleQuestions.question: What should a consultant establish before designing the data model?
options: Which reporting tool the institution intends to use after go-live
How the institution is structured and how students move through it
How many custom fields the institution has created in its previous system
Which Salesforce licence type each member of staff has been assigned
sampleQuestions.explanation: The model has to fit the real academic structure and student lifecycle, so understanding those comes before any object design.
whyWrong: Reporting tooling is downstream of the data model.
A count of legacy fields says little about what is needed now.
Licensing is a commercial detail that follows the design.

sampleQuestions.question: Which best describes what Education Cloud is intended to support?
options: The student relationship from enquiry to alumnus
The timetabling of classrooms and teaching staff across each academic term
The delivery of course content and assessment to enrolled students online
The payroll and contracts of the academic staff employed by the institution
sampleQuestions.explanation: It covers recruitment, admissions, enrolment, advising, retention and alumni relations as one continuous relationship.
whyWrong: Timetabling is handled by specialist scheduling systems.
Content delivery is a learning management system's role.
Staff payroll belongs in human resources.
